mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_category (user_id, category_id, color, name) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{color}, #{name})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_category SET color = #{color}, name = #{name} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_category WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category_id = #{categoryId}
